summary: Willamette NF platform lookout in Lane County, dated to the 1930s, staffed in 1938, and gone by 1957; no source describes what remains.

facts.design: open wooden platform tower (height disputed: 30 ft in the register, 20 ft on Rex's page)
facts.status_note: Gone by 1957 per the register and firelookout.com; Rex's page says it was abandoned in the 1950s

staffing.status: lookout fireman stationed for the summer of 1938

events.note: Register and firelookout.com say only built in the 1930s; 1930 is the start of that decade, not a dated record
Charles Wert stationed there for the summer as lookout fireman, per a July 28, 1938 Eugene Guard item quoted on Rex's page

notes_for_editor: The register says a 30-foot tower and Rex's page says 20 feet (c.1940). The record's height_m of 6.1 matches Rex, not the register; the two heights appear in the design field only because the sources disagree. The record's elevation of 1970.2 m matches the register's 6,464 ft. Both sources give only 'the 1930s' for the build, so the built event and the abandoned event use the decade start as their year and say so in the notes. No source describes what remains; the remains heading on Rex's page has no text in our copy. The 1938 item, as quoted on Rex's page, spells the butte 'Immigrant Butte'. The story treats it as this lookout because Rex's page files it under Emigrant Butte; the spelling is worth a check.
